The commercial quantity for morphine is 250 grams. items.summary: The Madras High Court on Tuesday upheld the Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker’s decision to accept the resignations of six MLAs who switched allegiance to the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) party soon after they were elected on an AIADMK ticket [ Agri Krishnamurthy v. Speaker ]. A Bench of Chief Justice SA Dharmadhikari and Justice Arul Murugan , however, also held that acceptance of the resignations did not render disqualification proceedings pending against the MLAs academic or infructuous. The Speaker must still adjudicate those proceedings, and his determination would carry the consequences prescribed under the Tenth Schedule (concerning political defection) of the Constitution, the Court said. The Court, therefore, directed the Speaker to decide the pending disqualification proceedings against the former AIADMK MLAs within two months. CJ SA Dharmadhikari and Justice Arul Murugan The Court passed the verdict on a plea filed by AIADMK leader and party Whip Agri Krishnamurthy.
